aliases: Tao Zhu's true inheritance five regional true inheritance five regional inheritance

summary.text: Tao Zhu true inheritance is the restriction path true inheritance Restriction Expert Tao Zhu sealed in Five Regional Mountain Range.

claims.text: Qiao clan had obtained clues to Tao Zhu’s inheritance and had been secretly exploring how to excavate it. Under Wu Yong’s pressure they offered those findings, and a formation run by Wu clan and Qiao clan changed the earth vein under Five Regional Mountain Range until the range crumbled. Qiao Si Liu thought destroying the range ended any hope of exploring that rank eight inheritance, then heard Tao Zhu’s will announce that destroying the mountain range was the final test and that the five regions inheritance now belonged to the inheritor. The immortals on the field ignored the will in order to keep attacking Fang Yuan, saying they could take the inheritance after the battle.

Fang Yuan later judged that Tao Zhu’s true inheritance was related to the five regions’ regional walls, that a method of imitating those walls could be used to defend, and that missing it by a hairsbreadth was a severe loss.

After Fang Yuan used a tribulation pretense to trap pursuers in Five Regional Mountain Range, the Southern Alliance still obtained Tao Zhu’s true inheritance even though Wu Yong could not deal with Fang Yuan there.

Wu Yong tells Fang Yuan that he obtained the five regional true inheritance and that there is a method in it to create the five regional walls. Chi Qu You added that this method uses the earth veins to set up the formation, and that it is very troublesome and complicated. Fang Yuan had already deduced that the five regional true inheritance could mimic the five regions’ regional walls, so that Gu Immortals inside would be suppressed and would face backlash when they used immortal killer moves. After Fang Yuan left the Five Regional Mountain Range battlefield, Wu Yong obtained the inheritance and found that its essence was the five regional formation. Wu clan was not proficient in formation path, so Wu Yong worked with Chi Qu You, who also learned that profundity. Tao Zhu had been able to create Five Regional Mountain Range because he used the earth vein and a formation.

Chen Yi of Heavenly Court identifies the five colored smoke as originating from the five regional true inheritance, the method of Southern Border’s Tao Zhu. Heavenly Court already knew detailed information about Tao Zhu’s true inheritance from the Five Regional Mountain Range battle, when Jun Shen Guang was captured. The smoke imitates the five regional walls and makes Heavenly Court’s side suffer backlash, getting around nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation by targeting the Gu Immortals instead of the formation layers. The five regional true inheritance was able to counter nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation. Inside the smoke, people strengthened by Heroes Among People faced steeper backlash as their killer moves were amplified. Fang Yuan inwardly sighed that if he could obtain Tao Zhu’s true inheritance, his battle strength would rise sharply.

In order for Tao Zhu’s true inheritance to appear, the entire Five Regional Mountain Range had to be destroyed. Fang Yuan used a method that targeted that earth vein arrangement, the five colored lights vanished, and Tao Zhu’s will appeared and named the five regional inheritance as the prize for passing the final test. Fang Yuan pulled the will out, named himself a current generation demon, and took the entire true inheritance without the will’s consent. He told the will he would use the inheritance when he dominated the world and invaded Heavenly Court, and that he would not fight a dead person over reputation while pursuing eternal life. Tao Zhu’s will then offered the inheritance and a true meaning hidden elsewhere.

After obtaining the entirety of Tao Zhu’s true inheritance, Fang Yuan left Five Regional Mountain Range immediately. Even though Tao Zhu was only rank eight, the importance of this true inheritance surpassed even some venerable true inheritances. In the previous life Fang Yuan had used Tao Zhu’s methods against nine-nine consecutive unceasing formation and against Heroes Among People: inside five colored smoke, the stronger the move, the greater the backlash. Tao Zhu named the formation Five Regional Limit Formation. Five Regional Limit Formation and five restriction profound light qi are the essence of the true inheritance. Five restriction profound light qi shoots five colored light qi whose effect is similar to regional walls, and Fang Yuan is not restricted inside that light qi.

The true inheritance also held two rule path Immortal Gu: rank eight Region, Tao Zhu’s vital Gu, and rank seven Limit. Both the formation and the killer move used Region and Limit as cores with a vast number of supplementary mortal Gu. Tao Zhu’s immortal aperture was not preserved. According to the true inheritance he was very poor, having used most of his resources on research, and before dying he left his immortal aperture to Southern Border’s righteous path so he could conceal the true inheritance. Tao Zhu’s true inheritance had clearly stated that Five Regional Limit Formation needed to be set up on the ground and rooted to an earth vein. In the previous life Chi Qu You added earth vein Immortal Gu for that reason.

Tao Zhu’s will then handed Fang Yuan a hidden true meaning that could raise a person with no rule path foundation to great grandmaster at once. Fang Yuan absorbed it and became a rule path great grandmaster. Restriction path is a sub branch of rule path that had not fully separated, which is why Tao Zhu cultivated restriction path yet left a rule path true meaning. Southern Border’s righteous path had obtained the true inheritance in the previous life but not this true meaning.

Fang Yuan’s main body practiced killer moves and focused on the contents of Tao Zhu’s true inheritance, activating five restriction profound light qi. He could only unleash one type at first, southern restriction purple-black miasma light qi. The other four are central restriction white-gold saint light qi, northern restriction jade licorice light qi, western restriction red raging flame light qi, and eastern restriction blue water light qi. He could not use Five Regional Limit Formation then because earth vein Immortal Gu had not appeared, and even with it he would still need to modify the formation to add Formation Spirit and formation flag Gu.

Wu Yong explains to Southern Alliance immortals that a large formation emitting five colored smoke miasma was created by Southern Border Gu Immortal Tao Zhu, is called the five regional limit formation, and can emit smoke miasma to create a formation similar to the environment of the five regions’ regional walls.
